title: Unsaved Changes Bar
summary: Names every unsaved field, warns before the tab closes, saves on Ctrl/⌘+S and asks twice before discarding.
description: Unsaved-changes bar that names every dirty field (with per-field revert), guards the tab close, saves on Ctrl/⌘+S and asks twice before Discard; editing a field back to its saved value makes it clean again.
catches: Fields edited back to their saved value (clean again, deep compare)
Closing the tab with unsaved edits (beforeunload)
Discard, which needs a second confirm
Save failures, shown as an error
limits: In-app navigation must be guarded by your router; only tab close is covered
Browsers show their own generic leave-page text
a11y: Region with an aria-label; changed fields list has an aria-label
Ctrl/⌘+S saves (aria-keyshortcuts); revert buttons have aria-labels
Discard confirm is a labelled group focused on Keep; Escape cancels
Errors use role=alert; status in a polite live region
